observation.visible_scene: An indoor living room: a striped rug on a parquet floor, a blue exercise ball resting against furniture at the left edge, a tall white display cabinet and an open white shelving unit on the right, a flat-screen TV on a low white media stand, and framed pictures plus a string of lights on the walls. A girl with a dark ponytail, white short-sleeved shirt, maroon leggings and pink socks is seated on a large purple exercise ball positioned near the center of the rug, facing the TV.
visible_changes: The girl repeatedly bounces up and down on the purple ball; her torso and head rise and fall relative to the cabinet behind her across the sequence.

The purple ball alternates between a compressed, flattened shape (when she is at the bottom of a bounce) and a fuller, more spherical shape (when she is at the top), i.e. it deforms vertically rather than translating as a rigid body.
Her feet in pink socks are mostly lifted off the floor, swinging slightly forward and back with each bounce, sometimes approaching the TV stand.
The purple ball shifts a little horizontally on the rug between bounces but remains roughly centered; the blue ball on the left stays stationary throughout.
The dark shape seen on the TV screen is a reflection of the girl and ball that moves in sync with her, not a separate object.
The background (pictures, cabinets, rug edges) holds fixed positions across frames, indicating no camera movement.
outside_clip_unknowns: How the bouncing was initiated (no start is shown; motion is already underway at the first frame).
Whether the bouncing continues or stops after the last frame (motion is ongoing at the crop boundary).
uncertain_details: The exact period and amplitude of each bounce are hard to time precisely from the sampled frames.
The small left-right drift of the purple ball is minor and may be partly bounce-induced rather than deliberate movement.
Some frames show motion blur on the girl, so instantaneous posture is approximate.
